notes: ✨ Build me a workout (Pro): on the Train tab, tap “Build me a workout”, say what you want (explosive legs for jumping, a bigger bench, an easy recovery day…), pick one of your gyms or “Any gym” and how long you have. Your coach writes the whole session from your lifts, goals and recovery: a name, exercises in order, sets, reps and a cue for each. Start it right away, save it as a workout day, or ask for a change.
